title: VPN disconnects or fails to connect
symptoms: VPN disconnects after connecting, connection timeout, or authentication error
steps: Confirm whether the corporate status page reports a VPN outage.
Disconnect and reconnect after checking the device clock and internet connection.
Record the VPN client version and exact error message if the issue continues.
escalate_when: The status page shows an outage, multiple users are affected, or the error persists after these checks.

title: Forgotten password or locked account
symptoms: Cannot sign in, forgotten password, or account locked
steps: Use the approved self-service password reset portal.
If self-service fails, contact the service desk for identity verification.
Never share a password or one-time code in the ticket.
escalate_when: The requester cannot pass identity verification, the account may be compromised, or the reset does not restore access.

title: Install an approved application
symptoms: Install software, license an application, or request an approved app
steps: Confirm the application name, device, operating system, and business purpose.
Check the approved software catalog and its license requirements.
Use the managed software portal to request installation.
escalate_when: The application is absent from the approved catalog or a license or admin approval is required.

title: MFA prompt not arriving
symptoms: No MFA prompt, lost authenticator device, or sign-in verification unavailable
steps: Check device connectivity and the authenticator app's time settings.
Use an approved backup method if one is already registered.
Contact the service desk for verified recovery if no approved method works.
escalate_when: The user has lost all factors, reports a suspicious prompt, or identity cannot be verified.
